corpus_dropped.reason: No lateral movement: the advisory explicitly states 'Analysts did not observe evidence of privilege escalation or lateral movement.' There is an entry host (the IIS web server) but no hop between two identified hosts, so per the BRIEF (entry host AND one hop required) this case is dropped. Retained for the corpus as a documented single-host web-server compromise.

No concrete lateral hop between identifiable hosts. The menuPass plan is advisory/environment-agnostic: it names infrastructure only by role and describes lateral movement abstractly ('to systems of interest'), giving no specific A->B edge to model, so it fails the entry + >=1 concrete hop requirement.

No lateral hop. The Blind Eagle emulation (and the real campaign) operates entirely on one victim workstation ('exploitation of a single workstation'); there is an entry host but no movement to a second machine, so it fails the entry + >=1 hop requirement.

No lateral hop. The ToolShell flow is a single-server RCE + credential (MachineKey) theft + ViewState persistence chain entirely on the SharePoint server; there is an internet-facing entry but no movement to a second internal host, so it fails the entry + >=1 hop requirement.

Entry point known (employee downloaded a malicious file) but no incident-specific lateral hop between identified hosts is publicly described. The BRIEF requires entry host AND one hop between identified hosts, so dropped.
Initial access vector not publicly disclosed and no lateral hop between identified hosts is described. Entry-point-plus-hop requirement unmet, so dropped per the BRIEF.

No lateral hop between identified hosts: each victim compromise was a valid-credential logon into one Snowflake SaaS tenant with data exfiltration, not host-to-host movement. Entry point exists but the required hop does not, so dropped per the BRIEF.
No public entry point + lateral hop between identified hosts. ENISA confirmed ransomware and the impacted MUSE platform, but no technical intrusion path was published, so dropped per the BRIEF.

No public source describes a specific entry host AND one lateral hop between identified hosts. JLR did not disclose technical details; NCSC gave only a statement. Required entry-point-plus-hop detail is absent, so dropped per the BRIEF.
